items.title: Voluntary data submission pilot to advance innovative alternatives to animal testing
items.summary: EMA has launched a new voluntary data submission (VDS) pilot to facilitate the sharing of data generated using New Approach Methodologies (NAMs). These innovative methods have…

items.title: Roche’s phase 3 win tees up fight with Novartis for blockbuster kidney disease market
items.summary: Roche has reported a phase 3 win for sefaxersen in kidney disease, teeing up talks with regulators about the path to approval for the Ionis-partnered, would-be blockbuster candidate.

items.title: Mirum bags FDA approval for ultra-rare bone lesion disorder, heating up rivalry with Regeneron
items.summary: Mirum's Atebrioz gained FDA approval for FOP on the heels of Regeneron's green light in the same indication last month.

items.title: Merck, Eisai’s Welireg-Lenvima combo lands FDA nod to jump the kidney cancer queue
items.summary: Merck & Co. has scored an FDA approval for its blockbuster-to-be Welireg to move into second-line treatment of kidney cancer, where analysts have projected a rapid uptake.

items.title: Fierce Pharma Asia—Lilly’s $3.35B InnoCare deal; Korea’s breakthrough; China’s 5-year biotech plan
items.summary: Eli Lilly and InnoCare Pharma inked a multi-target deal potentially worth $3.35 billion. The FDA has doled out the first approval for a novel cancer drug from a Korean company. China's new pharmaceuticals five-year plan includes some ambitious goals. And more.

items.title: Elevar wins FDA nod for bile duct cancer drug Lyrfigtu, a first for a Korean firm
items.summary: The FDA has green-lighted Elevar’s FGFR2-selective inhibitor Lyrfigtu in bile duct cancer, making it the first novel cancer drug from a Korean company to secure FDA approval.

items.title: Regulatory tracker: EC win marks 3rd asthma approval for AZ's Breztri
items.summary: In this tracker, Fierce Pharma is recording the regulatory progress of in-market products, including expansions into key geographies and new indications. Some of these updates may not meet the bar for standalone stories, but we think they are still worth mentioning.

items.title: New EU supply chain to end Visudyne shortage
items.summary: A new supply chain for Visudyne (verteporfin) has been put in place in the European Union (EU), marking an important step towards resolving a long-standing shortage of the…, This situation shows the complexity of shortages and how coordination between the European Commission, EU Member States, MSSG and SPOC Working Party can ensure fair…, Medicine shortages

items.title: Trump's FDA pick Heidi Overton calls vaccines, mifepristone safe and effective in confirmation hearing
items.summary: The Senate Committee on Health, Education, Labor and Pensions (HELP) today questioned Heidi Overton, M.D., Ph.D., Trump’s pick for FDA commissioner, in a hearing marked by tightrope-walking on issues like vaccines, abortions, flavored vapes and whether or not President Donald Trump is capable of being wrong.

items.title: Acadia misses mark in Alzheimer’s but concludes phase 3 ‘absolutely worth’ pursuing
items.summary: Acadia Pharmaceuticals’ phase 2 Alzheimer’s disease trial has missed its primary endpoint, but the company and analysts alike saw enough encouraging signals to support the continuation of a phase 3 program.

items.title: Grail survives adcomm vote as it awaits FDA decision for cancer blood test
items.summary: Despite a major trial setback earlier this year and increasing questions over its efficacy, medtech Grail has beaten the odds and seen a positive recommendation for its multi-cancer blood test Galleri from FDA advisors.

items.title: Roche pens backloaded $2B deal with Atavistik to discover allosteric CVRM drugs
items.summary: Roche has penned a backloaded $2 billion deal with hematology biotech Atavistik Bio to develop allosteric small molecules for cardiometabolic diseases.

items.title: Merck sees pivotal victory for $3B eye disease prospect
items.summary: Merck & Co.’s Brunello trial has hit its primary endpoint, shedding light on the effects of a trispecific diabetic macular edema (DME) drug candidate that the Big Pharma bought in a $3 billion takeover.

items.title: Immunovant ends cutaneous lupus program after phase 2 flop
items.summary: Immunovant has stopped development of IMVT-1402 in cutaneous lupus erythematosus after failing a midphase test, closing off one path to market for the anti-FcRn antibody.

items.title: Anaconda Biomed snares $56M in funding for endovascular tech
items.summary: Medtech startup Anaconda Biomed has hauled in $53 million to help finish off work on a pivotal trial for its endovascular project.

items.title: Lilly brings more heat to Novo with FDA nod for once-weekly insulin Onswik
items.summary: After racking up a trio of regulatory wins overseas, Eli Lilly’s once-weekly insulin is coming home to open a new front in the company’s ongoing market showdown with Novo.

items.title: GSK slammed for ‘grossly misleading’ and ‘totally unacceptable’ behavior
items.summary: GSK showed a “totally unacceptable” lack of transparency in its interactions with the PMCPA, the U.K. self-regulatory body ruled.

items.title: Otsuka JV recalls one lot of sodium chloride over labeling issue
items.summary: Otsuka ICU Medical, a joint venture from Japan’s Otsuka Pharmaceutical Factory, issued a voluntary recall of one lot of 0.9% sodium chloride injection for IV due to a possible mix-up of labels.

items.title: 'Europe does not value what you do': 9 pharmas make urgent call for bloc to beef up innovation muscle
items.summary: As China and the U.S. presently duke it out over biopharma innovation supremacy, a clutch of Europe’s biggest drugmakers are calling on the bloc to not lose sight of its R&D roots.

items.title: Indivior ends PAM drug collab with Addex ahead of Supernus merger
items.summary: Ahead of its upcoming merger with Supernus, Indivior Pharmaceuticals has ended its long-running collaboration with Addex Therapeutics to develop positive allosteric modulators (PAMs).

items.title: Kyverna ‘resetting conversation’ with 1-year miv-cel data as autoimmune CAR-T peers hit safety snags
items.summary: As two Big Pharma players in the autoimmune CAR-T space face unexpected safety setbacks, Kyverna Therapeutics is reporting long-term clinical data that showcase sustained efficacy alongside an unblemished safety profile for its potential first-in-class candidate, miv-cel.

items.title: Lundbeck to move US digs to Boston as it eyes bigger innovation frontiers
items.summary: With Lundbeck steering its R&D engine toward increasingly specialized neuroscience targets, the Danish drugmaker is plotting a U.S. HQ move to one of the country’s preeminent biopharma hotspots.

items.title: Pioneer of China NewCo model sued in US over trade secret misuse, double-dealing
items.summary: A legal feud unfolding in New York is putting a spotlight on the work of a business development veteran who is credited for pioneering one of biopharma’s hottest dealmaking mechanism: the China “NewCo” model.

items.title: Chutes & Ladders—Travere chief makes way for former Amicus CEO
items.summary: Travere Therapeutics CEO Eric Dube, Ph.D., is stepping down after overseeing the launch of the rare kidney disease drug Filspari.

items.title: Novo inks $1.3B Nanexa deal to unlock long-acting obesity injectables
items.summary: Novo has struck a 1.17 billion euro ($1.3 billion) deal to combine Nanexa’s long-acting injectable drug delivery platform with its obesity and Type 2 diabetes drugs.

items.title: Roche's Genentech inks $1.5B bispecific pact with fast-rising Earendil
items.summary: Roche’s Genentech is paying Earendil Labs $55 million upfront to discover and develop multiple bispecific antibodies. The deal, which focuses on oncology, includes milestones that could take the deal's value above $1.5 billion.

items.title: ADARx scores upsized $446M IPO, while fellow RNA biotech City maps out Nasdaq plans
items.summary: ADARx Pharmaceuticals has overshot its own IPO ambitions, as fellow RNA-focused biotech City Therapeutics also plans a public listing.

items.title: ‘It’s actually very radical’: NIH debuts tool to help scientists navigate biomedical database
items.summary: The NIH’s National Library of Medicine has released the pilot version of a new tool designed to help scientists plumbing the library’s digital trove of scientific papers find related research faster.

items.title: China’s Henlius carves out $440M T-cell engager deal with Amberstone
items.summary: Fosun Pharma subsidiary Henlius Biotech has signed a $440 million biobucks deal with California-based Amberstone Biosciences to work on T-cell engagers.

items.title: Why a US senator wants a biotech leader in the White House who ‘has the president’s ear’
items.summary: Senator Todd Young (R-IN), chairman of the National Security Commission on Emerging Biotechnology, told Fierce why he's concerned about the growth of China's biopharma industry.

items.title: Adagio Medical kicks off strategic review, trims more than half its staff
items.summary: Adagio Medical has initiated a strategic review of its business and will lay off more than half its full-time workers as the maker of cryoablation devices faces delisting on the Nasdaq exchange.

items.title: Lilly puts up $100M, plus billions on the backend, to form 5-target deal with China's InnoCare
items.summary: Eli Lilly has committed $100 million in upfront and near-term payments to InnoCare Pharma to form a five-target drug discovery pact. The deal features up to $3.25 billion in milestones.

items.title: Enveda reaps $311M series E to feed ambition to become a ‘household name’
items.summary: Enveda has raised a $311 million series E round, positioning the nature-derived drug discovery company to pursue its goal of becoming a household name over the next decade.

items.title: Trump's Department of War bets $47M on Flagship biotechs to develop countermeasures
items.summary: The Department of War has awarded Flagship Pioneering $47 million to develop medical countermeasure technologies against emerging threats.

items.title: Boehringer adds $250M to value of Variant pact by expanding into cardiovascular disease
items.summary: Boehringer Ingelheim has dived deeper into its collaboration with Variant Bio by expanding the collaboration to cover cardiovascular disease to the tune of $250 million.

items.title: GSK aiming to ‘balance West and East’ after Hansoh deal success showed China’s potential
items.summary: GSK has been operating a strategy of “balancing the West and the East” since the Big Pharma’s eyes were opened to the potential of licensing drugs from China two years ago, according to an executive.

items.title: The Oral GLP-1 Tracker: Prescriptions bounce back from holiday lull
items.summary: Fierce Pharma is launching the weekly Oral GLP-1 Tracker, leveraging analysts’ notes and IQVIA data to monitor prescription trends and shifting market shares as Novo Nordisk's Wegovy pill and Eli Lilly's Foundayo vie to become the go-to oral weight-loss solution for millions.
